description: Use this when the user asks for nomado24's job market statistics: active remote and hybrid jobs and companies in the public report, new postings in the last 7 and 30 days, the breakdown by source and work arrangement, and salary ranges across postings with salary data. The report counts only the sources named in its sourcePolicy field, so its total can be lower than the board; say so when you quote it. Do not use it to find jobs. No input required.
name: get_job_statistics
title: Job board statistics
